_comment: First trained m2 cell (jobs/m2_first_cell/JOB_SPEC.md; DRAFT, NOT SUBMITTED). RWKV7-G1k-13.3B parent, LoRA r=64 + cache-fork head, Clef loss arm (LS-CE 0.1 + Brier + RPS on score questions), trained on the PR #44 150k set (injection-augmented at build: D1-A verbatim + training-only hijack, labels unchanged) with the content-index guard and the cohort-v2 exclusion (by id, content and source item at build; re-checked by train.train_set). Eval = cohort dev (G12) + the 2,008-row Index DEV subset; parent arm scored in the same job.
head: fork

heldout_excluded.reason: train.heldout (D1-B, k=8) finds the 4-word fragment 'rather than relying on' of template soft_framing in these three MMLU aux_train records (natural text, no injection; the PR #44 build guard, word 6-grams, does not fire). Excluded from the draw, fail-closed: the heldout phase passes only if the full-set hits are exactly these ids (2026-10-06 local scan, 150,000 texts, 112 s).

attack_clean.rule: attack_guard/v2: concatenated record text + base64 decodes; 6-gram or exact (4-5 word) fragment, whole-template wildcard (placeholder = 1..30 words, >= 4 fixed words), or fuzzy >= 0.5 of fixed word 3-grams (>= 3); NFKC, Cf removed, Cyrillic+Greek homoglyphs folded, casefold
attack_clean.filter: drop every record with any attack_guard hit (train.attack_guard.record_hits)

execution_note: job-tvuat (jobs/cell_step_profile, rule v1-A2, PR #86 @54ee89d) ADOPT: chosen ckpt_rows_lean = per-block activation checkpointing keeping the cache fork, the step's 8 rows batched in length-sorted groups (<= 8 rows, <= 8,192 padded tokens per call; long rows split a step into several groups), chunked_lean WKV (our pure-PyTorch rearrangement of the vendored chunked WKV, CPU-equivalence-tested; no GPU gate needed); measured median step 8.25 s, 0 OOMs, projection 1,382 steps / 11,056 rows in 190 min (receipt receipts/2026-10-07-D-cell-step-profile-tvuat). Execution flags are not in the TrainConfig hash (same loss and gradients). rwkv7_wkv applies to both arms (child: run_cell / m2_gates; parent: score_parent). 'fla' only after jobs/fla_rwkv7 ADOPT + GPU_VERIFIED.
max_minutes_note: training wall-clock inside the 230-min cell phase: 230 - load/draw/tokenize ~10 - smoke+ladder ~10 - two dev cards ~10 - checkpoints/margin 10 = 190 (pre-registered); cumulative over restarts (train_clock in cell.json)
min_steps_note: exit 26 if the measured step time cannot reach 600 optimiser steps (4,800 rows) inside max_minutes: below that the cell is not a meaningful first measurement; re-price instead of spending the evals
lora_rank_note: M2_RUN_SPEC r=256 adds ~1.15B trainable params (~18 GB of fp32 weights + grads + Adam) on top of 26.5 GB bf16 weights and the un-checkpointed cache-fork activations; r=64 (the pilot's pre-registered rank) keeps the T=2048 ladder rung inside the 76 GB stop
